title: OS command execution via execShellCmd (nim) — review required
description: The nim sink execShellCmd launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via execProcess with args.
remediation: Use execProcess with args with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any execShellCmd call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
